name: GalviVault Day 2 QA Identity Continuity

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: galvivault-day2-qa
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  DAY2_ALLOWED_ORIGIN: https://galvipro.com
  CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
  CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}

jobs:
  day2-identity-continuity:
    name: Build, migrate, deploy, and prove Day 2
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25

    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact QA candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node 22
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"

      - name: Assert approved branch, QA authority, and Production isolation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" = "qa-revamped-galvicare-0-5"
          node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
          import fs from 'node:fs';
          const day1=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('wrangler.json','utf8'));
          const day2=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('wrangler.day2.json','utf8'));
          const production=fs.readFileSync('wrangler.production.jsonc','utf8');
          if(day1.main!=='worker/day1.js') throw new Error('Day 1 entry is not preserved.');
          if(day2.name!==day1.name||day2.main!=='worker/day2.js') throw new Error('Day 2 is not extending the isolated GalviVault QA Worker.');
          if(day2.vars?.ENVIRONMENT!=='qa'||day2.vars?.MIN_SCHEMA_VERSION!=='0002') throw new Error('Day 2 QA variables are invalid.');
          const db=day2.d1_databases?.find(item=>item.binding==='DB');
          if(db?.database_name!=='galvivault-0-5-qa'||db?.migrations_dir!=='migrations/day1') throw new Error('Day 2 QA D1 target is invalid.');
          if(!production.includes('worker/production-entry.js')||production.includes('worker/day2.js')) throw new Error('Production entry separation failed.');
          if(production.includes('galvivault-0-5-qa')||production.includes('cdf9042b-ab09-498a-ac66-010b6cce47d4')) throw new Error('Production configuration contains QA D1 authority.');
          console.log('PASS: branch, Day 1 preservation, Day 2 QA authority, and Production isolation are valid.');
          NODE

      - name: Install locked repository dependencies
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts || npm install --ignore-scripts

      - name: Verify Day 2 critical-path files and configuration
        run: npm run verify:galvivault:day2

      - name: Run Day 1 regression
        run: npm run test:day1

      - name: Run GalviVault Day 2 blocking suite
        run: npm run test:galvivault:day2

      - name: Prove preserved Production and Day 7D source boundaries
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --check worker/production-entry.js
          node --check worker/day7d-engine.js
          node --test tests/day7b-environment-isolation.test.mjs
          echo 'PASS: Production and Day 7D source boundaries remain valid.'

      - name: Apply additive migrations 0001 and 0002 to isolated QA D1
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npx --yes wrangler@4 d1 migrations apply galvivault-0-5-qa \
            --remote \
            --config wrangler.day2.json

      - name: Verify remote Day 2 migration ledger, columns, and unique indexes
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SQL="SELECT migration_id,name,environment FROM gv1_schema_migrations WHERE migration_id IN ('0001','0002') ORDER BY migration_id; SELECT COUNT(*) AS day2_unique_indexes FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index' AND name IN ('ux_gv1_founders_normalized_email','ux_gv1_bmr_one_per_venture','ux_gv1_roles_one_active_primary'); SELECT COUNT(*) AS normalized_email_column FROM pragma_table_info('gv1_founders') WHERE name='normalized_email'; SELECT COUNT(*) AS response_json_column FROM pragma_table_info('gv1_idempotency_keys') WHERE name='response_json';"
          npx --yes wrangler@4 d1 execute galvivault-0-5-qa \
            --remote \
            --command="$SQL" \
            --config wrangler.day2.json \
            --json > /tmp/day2-schema.json
          cat /tmp/day2-schema.json
          node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
          import fs from 'node:fs';
          const payload=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/day2-schema.json','utf8'));
          const objects=[];
          const walk=(value)=>{
            if(Array.isArray(value)) for(const item of value) walk(item);
            else if(value&&typeof value==='object'){
              objects.push(value);
              for(const item of Object.values(value)) walk(item);
            }
          };
          walk(payload);
          const value=(key)=>objects.find(item=>Object.hasOwn(item,key))?.[key];
          if(!objects.find(item=>item.migration_id==='0001')) throw new Error('Migration 0001 ledger evidence is missing.');
          if(!objects.find(item=>item.migration_id==='0002')) throw new Error('Migration 0002 ledger evidence is missing.');
          if(Number(value('day2_unique_indexes'))!==3) throw new Error('Expected all three Day 2 unique indexes.');
          if(Number(value('normalized_email_column'))!==1) throw new Error('normalized_email column is missing.');
          if(Number(value('response_json_column'))!==1) throw new Error('response_json column is missing.');
          console.log('PASS: Day 2 schema 0002 and constraints are active in QA D1.');
          NODE

      - name: Deploy exact Day 2 candidate to isolated GalviVault QA Worker
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npx --yes wrangler@4 deploy --config wrangler.day2.json 2>&1 | tee /tmp/day2-deploy.log
          DAY2_BASE_URL="$(grep -Eo 'https://[[:alnum:].-]+\.workers\.dev' /tmp/day2-deploy.log | tail -n 1 || true)"
          if [ -z "$DAY2_BASE_URL" ]; then
            echo 'FAIL: Wrangler deployment did not emit a workers.dev URL.'
            cat /tmp/day2-deploy.log
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "DAY2_BASE_URL=$DAY2_BASE_URL" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "Authoritative Day 2 deployment URL: $DAY2_BASE_URL"

      - name: Wait for Day 2 runtime convergence
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for attempt in $(seq 1 60); do
            STATUS="$(curl --silent --show-error --location \
              --output /tmp/day2-ready-body \
              --dump-header /tmp/day2-ready-headers \
              --write-out '%{http_code}' \
              -H "Origin: ${DAY2_ALLOWED_ORIGIN}" \
              "${DAY2_BASE_URL}/api/v1/day2/readiness?candidate=${GITHUB_SHA}&attempt=${attempt}" || true)"
            if [ "$STATUS" = "200" ] && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/day2-ready-body','utf8')); if(p?.success!==true||p?.environment!=='qa'||p?.data?.ready!==true||p?.data?.current_schema_version!=='0002') process.exit(1);"; then
              echo "PASS: Day 2 runtime converged on attempt ${attempt}."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "Waiting for Day 2 runtime convergence: attempt=${attempt}, status=${STATUS}"
            sleep 3
          done
          echo 'FAIL: Day 2 endpoint did not converge.'
          cat /tmp/day2-ready-headers || true
          head -c 2000 /tmp/day2-ready-body || true
          exit 1

      - name: Run deployed Day 1 regression smoke against Day 2 wrapper
        env:
          DAY1_BASE_URL: ${{ env.DAY2_BASE_URL }}
          DAY1_RUN_SUFFIX: day2-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
        run: npm run qa:smoke

      - name: Run Day 2 remote E2E H2.1 through H2.9
        env:
          DAY2_RUN_SUFFIX: ${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          DAY2_EVIDENCE_PATH: /tmp/day2-e2e.json
        run: npm run smoke:galvivault:day2:qa

      - name: Verify remote identity, BMR, session, version, audit, and no-orphan assertions
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          RUN_SUFFIX="${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}"
          EMAIL="founder.day2.${RUN_SUFFIX}@example.test"
          SQL="SELECT COUNT(*) AS founder_count FROM gv1_founders WHERE normalized_email=lower(trim('${EMAIL}')); SELECT venture_id,COUNT(*) AS bmr_count FROM gv1_business_medical_records GROUP BY venture_id HAVING COUNT(*)<>1; SELECT COUNT(*) AS orphan_roles FROM gv1_founder_venture_roles r LEFT JOIN gv1_founders f ON f.founder_id=r.founder_id LEFT JOIN gv1_ventures v ON v.venture_id=r.venture_id WHERE f.founder_id IS NULL OR v.venture_id IS NULL; SELECT COUNT(*) AS mismatched_sessions FROM gv1_assessment_sessions s LEFT JOIN gv1_business_medical_records b ON b.bmr_id=s.bmr_id WHERE b.bmr_id IS NULL OR b.venture_id<>s.venture_id; SELECT COUNT(*) AS duplicate_founder_emails FROM (SELECT normalized_email FROM gv1_founders WHERE normalized_email IS NOT NULL GROUP BY normalized_email HAVING COUNT(*)>1);"
          npx --yes wrangler@4 d1 execute galvivault-0-5-qa \
            --remote \
            --command="$SQL" \
            --config wrangler.day2.json \
            --json > /tmp/day2-d1-assertions.json
          cat /tmp/day2-d1-assertions.json
          node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
          import fs from 'node:fs';
          const payload=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/day2-d1-assertions.json','utf8'));
          const objects=[];
          const walk=(value)=>{
            if(Array.isArray(value)) for(const item of value) walk(item);
            else if(value&&typeof value==='object'){
              objects.push(value);
              for(const item of Object.values(value)) walk(item);
            }
          };
          walk(payload);
          const value=(key)=>objects.find(item=>Object.hasOwn(item,key))?.[key];
          if(Number(value('founder_count'))!==1) throw new Error(`founder_count must equal 1; found ${value('founder_count')}.`);
          for(const key of ['orphan_roles','mismatched_sessions','duplicate_founder_emails']){
            if(Number(value(key))!==0) throw new Error(`${key} must equal 0; found ${value(key)}.`);
          }
          const badBmr=objects.find(item=>Object.hasOwn(item,'bmr_count'));
          if(badBmr) throw new Error(`A Venture has ${badBmr.bmr_count} BMR records.`);
          console.log('PASS: remote Day 2 canonical identity and integrity assertions are clean.');
          NODE

      - name: Capture evidence bundle
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p /tmp/day2-evidence
          cp /tmp/day2-deploy.log /tmp/day2-evidence/ 2>/dev/null || true
          cp /tmp/day2-schema.json /tmp/day2-evidence/ 2>/dev/null || true
          cp /tmp/day2-e2e.json /tmp/day2-evidence/ 2>/dev/null || true
          cp /tmp/day2-d1-assertions.json /tmp/day2-evidence/ 2>/dev/null || true
          printf '%s\n' \
            "repository=mrgalvipro/galvitriage" \
            "branch=${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" \
            "candidate_sha=${GITHUB_SHA}" \
            "workflow_run=${GITHUB_RUN_ID}" \
            "workflow_attempt=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}" \
            "qa_worker_url=${DAY2_BASE_URL:-unavailable}" \
            "qa_d1=galvivault-0-5-qa" \
            "schema=0002" > /tmp/day2-evidence/candidate.txt

      - name: Upload Day 2 evidence artifact
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: galvivault-day2-evidence-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: /tmp/day2-evidence
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Publish Day 2 gate summary
        if: success()
        run: |
          echo '## GALVIVAULT DAY 2 AUTOMATED + REMOTE E2E: PASS' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '- Branch: qa-revamped-galvicare-0-5' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '- Candidate SHA: ${{ github.sha }}' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- QA Worker URL: $DAY2_BASE_URL" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '- QA D1: galvivault-0-5-qa' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '- Migration 0002: PASS' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '- Day 1 regression: PASS' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '- Day 2 local blocking suite: PASS' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '- H2.1-H2.9 remote operator-harness execution: PASS' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '- Remote D1 identity and integrity assertions: PASS' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '- Production source/config changed: NO' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '**NEXT REQUIRED HUMAN EVIDENCE: capture the green workflow, download the evidence artifact, perform H2.10 Production regression, and record the final GO decision.**' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
